artifacts.summary: Route 1 (L-plus-indexed certificate over a label-free SharingSkeleton) in 22 phases across the research report's seven stages A-G, pinning 34 Lean declarations including (C5) StabFaithful, its decidability instance, and the agreement/non-vacuity/diagonal theorems that make it a real obligation.

memory_candidates.content: In this repo, .claude/scripts/lean-challenge-snapshot.sh cross-validates a lean plan's '## Lean Challenge Statements' block against its '**Goals**:' list, but both extractors are coarser than they look: the Goals regex only matches UNDOTTED backticked tokens (`foo`), so any dotted entry like `Ns.thm` is silently dropped from the goals set; and the declaration regex matches only theorem/lemma/def/instance (never `structure`) and captures only the FIRST dotted segment, so `def Ns.thm` registers as `Ns`. Consequence for plan authors: the Goals list must be written at namespace-head granularity matching what the tool extracts, every namespace head must appear as the head of at least one def/theorem/instance (a bare `structure` alone will not register it), and the precise per-declaration list belongs in a dotted-only sentence (invisible to the regex) or in the phase bodies. Verify with `bash .claude/scripts/lean-challenge-snapshot.sh <task> <root> --dry-run` before returning a plan; exit 71 is the identifier-set mismatch.
